install_mechanism_notes:
How installs work: the 'skills' CLI (vercel-labs/skills) is the existing mechanism. ~/.agents/.skill-lock.json records every current install. The global pattern is `npx skills add <owner/repo | GitHub tree URL> --skill <names...> -g -a claude-code -y`. -g installs at user level, -a claude-code targets Claude Code (~/.claude/skills), --skill accepts several names or '*', and -y skips prompts. Previous installs kept a canonical copy in ~/.agents/skills with symlinks in ~/.claude/skills. The lockfile's lastSelectedAgents list does NOT include claude-code, so always pass -a claude-code explicitly. Telemetry: the CLI sends anonymous usage data, and repo and skill IDs for public repos. Prefix commands with DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 (or DO_NOT_TRACK=1) to turn it off. Use `npx skills add <repo> --list` to preview skill names without installing.

Discovery: the CLI looks in skills/, .claude/skills/ and similar folders up to 3 levels deep, plus .claude-plugin manifests, and falls back to recursive search. MengTo/Skills uses agent-skills/<category>/<name>/ and depends on that fallback; use tree URLs if --skill does not match. The --skill value is the frontmatter name, not the folder name, e.g. vercel-react-view-transitions lives in skills/react-view-transitions.

Install pmndrs as a Claude Code plugin, not with npx skills (/plugin marketplace add pmndrs/claude-code-plugin, then /plugin install pmndrs@pmndrs). Its skills ('docs', 'examples') depend on the bundled pmndrs MCP server, and their generic names would collide if copied loose. GSAP and Addy's skills can also be installed as plugins (/plugin marketplace add greensock/gsap-skills; /plugin marketplace add addyosmani/web-quality-skills), but the npx route matches how the user's other skills are managed.

Next.js: vercel-labs/next-skills has moved to vercel/next.js/skills (canary). next-best-practices and next-upgrade are no longer skills. Next 16.3+ ships version-matched docs in node_modules/next/dist/docs and `next dev` generates AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md. Latest next on npm is 16.4.0, so a new project gets this automatically. On older 16.x, run `npx @next/codemod@canary agents-md`. The installed nextjs-app-router-patterns (wshobson, 'Next.js 14+') should be treated as secondary to those bundled docs.

There is no official Tailwind Labs, Motion (framer-motion) or Lenis agent skill. The installed tailwind-design-system covers Tailwind v4, Emil's animate covers Motion, and the MengTo Lenis skill covers Lenis.

After installing, restart Claude Code (or start a new session) so the new skills appear.

Nothing was installed during this research. All files were downloaded only to the session scratchpad as data, and no repo scripts were run.
